The Bank woul d like to place on record its sincere appreciation for the strategic vision and unwavering 
commitment demonstrated by Mr. Jagdishan throughout his distinguished tenure. His stewardship has been 
instrumental in strengthening the Bank’s performance, culture, and customer‑centric approach. The Bank 
also acknowledges his pivotal role in steer ing the successful completion of one of the largest mergers in 
corporate India. The Bank expresses its profound gratitude for his exemplary service and long association 
with the Bank over so many decades. 
 
The Bank warmly welcomes Mr. Anup Bagchi to his new role and looks forward to his leadership in 
advancing the Bank’s strategic priorities.
